text: {"score":4,"justification":"Numbers match the card and tool outputs (45.2% vs 8.1%, 5 of 11 below billed vs 9% peers, 8 of 30 charts, $2,854 CI $1,422-4,286, 1 of 21 data without lab). Cited claims match the evidence, and next steps are concrete. Weaknesses: the hedging line from the tool draft (\"reason to review, not a finding\") was dropped; the example C0260966 is a 99215 with 0 conditions that is documented as high MDM, so it undercuts the low-complexity point without comment; the rationale is repetitive and contains an odd contradiction (\"genuinely sick\" panel yet \"acuity explains part, not all\"); the overpayment estimate is stated with no caveat that it is draft/simulated; the missing-data caveat about the records exchange (wrong dates, partial, 68 days) is not mentioned. Also \"charts show moderate or low MDM on many 99215s\" slightly overstates 5 of 11.","problems":["Dropped the cautionary sentence that this is a reason to review, not a finding","Overpayment estimate given without the draft/simulated caveat","C0260966 is a supported high-MDM claim cited as an example without noting it contradicts the low-complexity concern","'Many 99215s' overstates 5 of 11 documented; small sample not flagged","Redundant, somewhat contradictory phrasing (genuinely sick panel vs. excess partly unexplained)","Does not flag the records exchange delays or that only 11 documented 99215s underlie the headline","8 of 30 random charts mixes 99213/99214 with the 99215 focus without clarification"]}
